name: filesystem
_register: claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope user filesystem -- npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem <ALLOWED_ROOT_1>
_purpose: Scoped filesystem access outside the project cwd. Replace <ALLOWED_ROOT_*> with absolute paths.
_warning: Each allowed root is read/write for the agent. Principle of least privilege — list only what is strictly needed. Never include ~/.ssh or credential dirs.
